content: Graceful shutdown in Go uses signal.NotifyContext to create context that cancels on SIGINT/SIGTERM. Pattern: ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM). For LIFO shutdown order, register components in order and shut down in reverse. Use context.Background() with timeout for operations that must complete. Check ctx.Done() in polling loops. Use sync.WaitGroup to track active goroutines.
